name: SUGARCREPE++
description: SUGARCREPE++ is a dataset designed to analyze the sensitivity of vision-and-language models (VLMs) and unimodal language models (ULMs) to lexical and semantic alterations. Each sample consists of an image and a triplet of captions posing a 3-way semantic (in)equivalence problem, challenging models to distinguish between semantic and lexical variations.
reputation: A newer multimodal robustness benchmark that has gained interest for probing semantic and lexical sensitivity in VLMs, but it is not yet as widely established as older vision-language benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on semantic and lexical sensitivity in vision-language models; highlights challenges in distinguishing lexical and semantic variations especially in object attributes and spatial relations.
